the secret to
weight loss.

cover.sub: Eat it or skip it. Same result.

study.headline: Adults trying to lose weight were told to eat breakfast, skip it, or got no advice. For 16 weeks.
study.note: Every group lost under 1 kg on average. The advice made no difference.
study.source: Dhurandhar et al., American Journal of Clinical Nutrition, 2014

verdict.headline:
Breakfast is
[y]optional.[/y]
Your calories aren't.
verdict.body: Eat in the morning if it keeps you full. Skip it if you're not hungry.

items: Not hungry in the morning? Skip it.
